# Bun

## Docs

- [Welcome to Bun](docs/index.md): Bun is an all-in-one toolkit for developing modern JavaScript/TypeScript applications.
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): Install Bun with npm, Homebrew, Docker, or the official script.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): Build your first app with Bun
- [TypeScript](docs/typescript.md): Using TypeScript with Bun, including type definitions and compiler options
- [TypeScript 6 and 7](docs/typescript-6.md): How to configure Bun's type definitions for TypeScript 6.0 and 7.0, which no longer auto-discover @types packages. Fix 'Cannot find name Bun' and other missing type errors after upgrading TypeScript.
- [bun init](docs/runtime/templating/init.md): Scaffold an empty Bun project with the interactive `bun init` command
- [bun create](docs/runtime/templating/create.md): Create a new Bun project from a React component, a `create-<template>` npm package, a GitHub repo, or a local template
- [Bun Runtime](docs/runtime/index.md): Execute JavaScript/TypeScript files, package.json scripts, and executable packages with Bun's fast runtime.
- [Watch Mode](docs/runtime/watch-mode.md): Automatic reloading in Bun with --watch and --hot modes
- [Debugging](docs/runtime/debugger.md): Debug your Bun code with an interactive debugger using WebKit Inspector Protocol
- [REPL](docs/runtime/repl.md): An interactive JavaScript and TypeScript REPL with syntax highlighting, history, and tab completion
- [bunfig.toml](docs/runtime/bunfig.md): Configure Bun's behavior using its configuration file bunfig.toml
- [File Types](docs/runtime/file-types.md): File types and loaders supported by Bun's bundler and runtime
- [Module Resolution](docs/runtime/module-resolution.md): How Bun resolves modules and handles imports in JavaScript and TypeScript
- [JSX](docs/runtime/jsx.md): Built-in JSX and TSX support in Bun with configurable transpilation options
- [Auto-install](docs/runtime/auto-install.md): Bun's automatic package installation feature for standalone script execution
- [Plugins](docs/runtime/plugins.md): Universal plugin API for extending Bun's runtime and bundler
- [File System Router](docs/runtime/file-system-router.md): Bun provides a fast API for resolving routes against file-system paths
- [Server](docs/runtime/http/server.md): Use `Bun.serve` to start a high-performance HTTP server in Bun
- [Routing](docs/runtime/http/routing.md): Define routes in `Bun.serve` using static paths, parameters, and wildcards
- [Cookies](docs/runtime/http/cookies.md): Work with cookies in HTTP requests and responses using Bun's built-in Cookie API.
- [TLS](docs/runtime/http/tls.md): Enable TLS in Bun.serve
- [Error Handling](docs/runtime/http/error-handling.md): Learn how to handle errors in Bun's development server
- [Metrics](docs/runtime/http/metrics.md): Monitor server activity with built-in metrics
- [Fetch](docs/runtime/networking/fetch.md): Send HTTP requests with Bun's fetch API
- [WebSockets](docs/runtime/http/websockets.md): Server-side WebSockets in Bun
- [TCP](docs/runtime/networking/tcp.md): Use Bun's native TCP API to implement performance-sensitive systems like database clients, game servers, or anything that needs to communicate over TCP (instead of HTTP)
- [UDP](docs/runtime/networking/udp.md): Use Bun's UDP API to implement services with advanced real-time requirements, such as voice chat.
- [DNS](docs/runtime/networking/dns.md): Use Bun's DNS module to resolve DNS records
- [Cookies](docs/runtime/cookies.md): Use Bun's native APIs for working with HTTP cookies
- [File I/O](docs/runtime/file-io.md): Bun provides a set of optimized APIs for reading and writing files.
- [Streams](docs/runtime/streams.md): Use Bun's streams API to work with binary data without loading it all into memory at once
- [Binary Data](docs/runtime/binary-data.md): Working with binary data in JavaScript
- [Archive](docs/runtime/archive.md): Create and extract tar archives with Bun's fast native implementation
- [SQL](docs/runtime/sql.md): Bun provides native bindings for working with SQL databases through a unified Promise-based API that supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.
- [SQLite](docs/runtime/sqlite.md): Bun natively implements a high-performance SQLite3 driver.
- [S3](docs/runtime/s3.md): Bun provides fast, native bindings for interacting with S3-compatible object storage services.
- [Redis](docs/runtime/redis.md): Use Bun's native Redis client with a Promise-based API
- [Workers](docs/runtime/workers.md): Use Bun's Workers API to create and communicate with a new JavaScript instance running on a separate thread while sharing I/O resources with the main thread
- [Environment Variables](docs/runtime/environment-variables.md): Read and configure environment variables in Bun, including automatic .env file support
- [Shell](docs/runtime/shell.md): Use Bun's shell scripting API to run shell commands from JavaScript
- [Spawn](docs/runtime/child-process.md): Spawn child processes with `Bun.spawn` or `Bun.spawnSync`
- [WebView](docs/runtime/webview.md): Control a headless browser from Bun for automation, testing, and scraping — zero dependencies on macOS, Chrome DevTools Protocol everywhere else
- [Cron](docs/runtime/cron.md): Schedule and parse cron jobs with Bun
- [Node-API](docs/runtime/node-api.md): Use Bun's Node-API module to build native add-ons to Node.js
- [FFI](docs/runtime/ffi.md): Use Bun's FFI module to efficiently call native libraries from JavaScript
- [C Compiler](docs/runtime/c-compiler.md): Compile and run C from JavaScript with low overhead
- [Transpiler](docs/runtime/transpiler.md): Use Bun's transpiler to transpile JavaScript and TypeScript code
- [CSRF Protection](docs/runtime/csrf.md): Generate and verify CSRF tokens with Bun's built-in API
- [Secrets](docs/runtime/secrets.md): Use Bun's Secrets API to store and retrieve sensitive credentials securely
- [Console](docs/runtime/console.md): The console object in Bun
- [TOML](docs/runtime/toml.md): Use Bun's built-in support for TOML files through both runtime APIs and bundler integration
- [YAML](docs/runtime/yaml.md): Use Bun's built-in support for YAML files through both runtime APIs and bundler integration
- [Markdown](docs/runtime/markdown.md): Parse and render Markdown with Bun's built-in Markdown API, supporting GFM extensions and custom rendering callbacks
- [JSON5](docs/runtime/json5.md): Use Bun's built-in support for JSON5 files through both runtime APIs and bundler integration
- [XML](docs/runtime/xml.md): Use Bun's built-in support for XML through both runtime APIs and bundler integration
- [JSONL](docs/runtime/jsonl.md): Parse newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) with Bun's built-in streaming parser
- [HTMLRewriter](docs/runtime/html-rewriter.md): Use Bun's HTMLRewriter to transform HTML documents with CSS selectors
- [Image](docs/runtime/image.md): Decode, transform, and encode images with a fast native pipeline
- [Hashing](docs/runtime/hashing.md): Utility functions for hashing and verifying passwords with various cryptographically secure algorithms
- [Glob](docs/runtime/glob.md): Use Bun's fast native implementation of file globbing
- [Semver](docs/runtime/semver.md): Use Bun's semantic versioning API
- [Color](docs/runtime/color.md): Format colors as CSS, ANSI, numbers, hex strings, and more
- [Utils](docs/runtime/utils.md): Use Bun's utility functions to work with the runtime
- [Globals](docs/runtime/globals.md): Use Bun's global objects
- [Bun APIs](docs/runtime/bun-apis.md): Overview of Bun's native APIs available on the Bun global object and built-in modules
- [Web APIs](docs/runtime/web-apis.md): Web-standard APIs supported by Bun for server-side JavaScript
- [Node.js Compatibility](docs/runtime/nodejs-compat.md): Bun's compatibility status with Node.js APIs, modules, and globals
- [Roadmap](docs/project/roadmap.md): Bun's roadmap and long-term plans
- [Benchmarking](docs/project/benchmarking.md): How to benchmark Bun
- [Contributing](docs/project/contributing.md): Contributing to Bun
